Amp CLI

Usage: amp [options] [command]

Commands:

  version                       Print the version number and exit
  logout                        Log out by removing stored API key
  login                         Log in to Amp
  orb                           Commands for Amp-managed orbs
    system-metrics              Print historical orb system metrics for a thread URL or ID
    portal                      Register a portal for an existing process and print its URL; use "amp orb service start"
                                for long-lived servers
      access                    Set portal access
    service                     [alias: services] Manage long-lived services (dev servers, watchers) as supervised
                                processes that survive Amp CLI updates and restart on failure
      ensure                    Ensure every service declared in .amp/services.yaml is running and exposed at its portal
                                URLs
      start                     Start an undeclared ad-hoc supervised service, e.g.: amp orb service start preview
                                --command 'pnpm dev' --portal
      restart                   Restart a declared service from .amp/services.yaml or reload an existing ad-hoc service
      stop                      Stop a service
      status                    Show supervisor status for a service
      logs                      Show recent logs for a service
      list                      List orb services
    restart-processes           Refresh environment variables and restart all processes in an orb thread
    id-token                    Mint a short-lived OIDC token with a caller-chosen audience and print it to stdout
  portal                        Commands for accessing Amp portal URLs
    login-url                   Mint a single-use login URL (valid ~60s) that signs a non-browser client into an Amp
                                portal URL; fetching it once sets the portal session cookie and redirects to the portal
                                page
  clone                         Clone an Amp-hosted Project, Personal Plugins or Skills repository, or Workspace Plugins
                                or Skills repository
  git-setup                     Configure the Amp Git credential helper
  files                         Download files from Amp
    get                         Download a private Amp attachment
  top                           Show live active threads
  last                          [alias: l] Continue the last thread
  report-bug                    [alias: report, diagnostics] Report a bug with diagnostics from the amp --no-tui runner
                                in this directory
  threads                       [alias: t, thread] Manage threads
    new                         [alias: n] Create a new thread
    continue                    [alias: c] Continue an existing thread
    list                        [alias: l, ls] List all threads
    usage                       Show usage information for a thread
    visibility                  [alias: v] Show or set default visibility for this repository
    search                      [alias: find] Search threads
    color                       Set a thread color
    label                       Add labels to a thread
    share                       [alias: s] Share a thread
      multiplayer               Turn multiplayer on or off
        on                      Turn multiplayer on for the default duration (1 week)
        off                     Turn multiplayer off
        ttl                     Turn multiplayer on for a specific duration
    rename                      [alias: r] Rename a thread
    archive                     Archive a thread
    delete                      Delete a thread
    markdown                    [alias: md] Render thread as markdown
    export                      Export a thread as JSON
    raw                         [alias: raw-thread] Export raw actor thread data as JSON
  tools                         [alias: tool] Tool management commands
    list                        [alias: ls] List all active tools (including MCP tools)
    show                        Show details about an active tool
  plugins                       [alias: plugin] Manage project, system, personal, and workspace plugins
    add                         Install a plugin from a URL
    remove                      [alias: rm] Remove an installed plugin
    update                      Update installed plugins or one imported shared plugin
    list                        [alias: ls] List loaded project, system, personal, and workspace plugins
    import                      Import a shared personal plugin into a plugin repository checkout
    repositories                [alias: repos] List available Personal Plugins and Workspace Plugins repositories
    show-agent-options          Show models and built-in tool names available to plugin agents
    exec                        Execute a plugin with a given event
    show-docs                   Output the plugin API documentation understood by this version of Amp
  skill                         [alias: skills] Manage skills from shared references, Git repositories, or local paths
    add                         Install skills from a source
    list                        [alias: ls] List all available skills
    remove                      [alias: rm] Remove an installed skill
    info                        Show information about a skill
    repositories                [alias: repos] List available Personal Skills and Workspace Skills repositories
  permissions                   [alias: permission] Manage permissions
    list                        [alias: ls] List permissions
    test                        Test permissions
    edit                        Edit permissions
    add                         Add permission rule
  mcp                           Manage MCP servers
    add                         Add an MCP server configuration
    list                        List available MCP servers
    remove                      Remove an MCP server configuration
    remote                      Manage MCP servers saved to ampcode.com
      list                      List stored remote MCP servers
      add                       Add a stored remote MCP server
      update                    Update a stored remote MCP server
      remove                    Remove a stored remote MCP server
      check                     Check a stored remote MCP server
      tools                     List tools for a stored remote MCP server
      login                     Log in to a stored remote MCP server
      logout                    Log out of a stored remote MCP server
    oauth                       Manage OAuth credentials for MCP servers in local CLI settings
      login                     Register OAuth client credentials for an MCP server
      logout                    Remove OAuth credentials for an MCP server
      status                    Show OAuth status for an MCP server
    doctor                      Check MCP server status
    approve                     Approve a workspace MCP server
  config                        Manage Amp configuration
    edit                        Open the Amp settings file in $EDITOR
    keymap                      List command keymap entries
    model-providers             Manage model provider keys and subscriptions
      list                      List model provider keys and subscriptions
      activate                  Activate a model provider key (deactivates any other active key of the same provider)
      deactivate                Deactivate a model provider key
      show                      Show complete non-secret model provider connection data as JSON
      delete                    Delete a model provider key or subscription
      test                      Test a model provider key or subscription
      check-access              Check which model provider serves a model by running a small inference
      add-router                Add an AI model router and select the models routed through it
      edit-router               Edit an AI model router
      setup-guide               Explain how to obtain the credential an AI model router needs
      edit-key                  Edit a model provider API key name or model mapping
      add-chatgpt-subscription  Link your ChatGPT subscription to Amp as a model provider by signing in to OpenAI in
                                your browser
    vocabulary                  Manage personal dictation vocabulary
      show                      Show personal dictation vocabulary (default)
      add                       Add terms without replacing existing vocabulary
      set                       Replace personal dictation vocabulary; omit terms to clear it
  domains                       Manage custom domains for sites
    list                        List custom domains, statuses, and required DNS records
    add                         Add a custom domain
    check                       Request an immediate DNS and provisioning status check
    remove                      [alias: rm] Remove a custom domain
  projects                      Manage Amp projects
    create                      Create an Amp-hosted project or map an existing Git repository
    update                      Update project settings by ID, [@]namespace/name, or repository
    list                        List projects accessible to you
    status                      Show the project matched by this directory's git remotes
    get                         Get a project by ID, [@]namespace/name, or repository
    snapshots                   Manage a project’s shared orb snapshots
      list                      List shared orb snapshots by project and orb size
      delete                    [alias: rm] Delete all shared orb snapshots, or one orb size with --resource
    gallery-media               Manage a project’s Amp Store gallery media
      get                       Print a project’s Amp Store gallery media as JSON
      set                       Set a project’s Amp Store gallery media from a JSON array of
                                {"type":"image"|"video","url":"<Amp artifact URL>","width":N,"height":N} items
    delete                      [alias: rm] Delete a project by ID, [@]namespace/name, or repository
  apps                          Manage workspace apps
    deploy                      Deploy a directory to a workspace app
    create                      Create a workspace app
    edit                        Edit a workspace app
    list                        List apps in a workspace
    deployments                 List deployment history for an app
    delete                      Delete a workspace app
  oauth-clients                 Manage workspace External API OAuth clients
    list                        List OAuth clients and client IDs
    create                      Create a Sign in with Amp OAuth client
    edit                        Edit a Sign in with Amp OAuth client
  secrets                       Manage environment variables and secrets for orbs and Apps
    list                        List secret and environment variable names
    history                     Show the change history of secrets and environment variables, including deletions
                                (values are never shown)
    get                         Get an environment variable value (secret values are never returned)
    set                         Add or update a secret or environment variable
    delete                      [alias: rm] Delete a secret or environment variable
  svc                           Call connected services and MCP servers through Amp
    gmail                       Call the connected Gmail account
      search_messages           Search Gmail messages
      read_message              Read one Gmail message
      list_labels               List Gmail labels
      create_draft              Create a Gmail draft
      send_message              Send a Gmail message
      send_draft                Send a Gmail draft
      modify_labels             Modify Gmail message labels
  usage                         Show your current Amp usage and credit balance
  update                        [alias: up] Update Amp CLI

Options:

  --visibility <visibility>
      Set thread visibility (private, unlisted, workspace, group)
  -V, --version
      Print the version number and exit
  -v
      Alias for --version
  --notifications
      Enable notification alerts (audio locally, terminal bell over SSH or with AMP_FORCE_BEL; enabled by default when
      not in execute mode)
  --no-notifications
      Disable notification alerts (audio locally, terminal bell over SSH or with AMP_FORCE_BEL; enabled by default when
      not in execute mode)
  --color
      Enable color output (enabled by default if stdout and stderr are sent to a TTY)
  --no-color
      Disable color output (enabled by default if stdout and stderr are sent to a TTY)
  --settings-file <value>
      Custom settings file path (overrides the default location /home/user/.config/amp/settings.json)
  --log-level <value>
      Set log level (parent, children, category, sinks, parentSinks, filters, lowestLevel, contextLocalStorage)
  --log-file <value>
      Set log file location (overrides the default location /home/user/.cache/amp/logs/cli.log)
  --ide
      Enable IDE connection (default). When enabled, Amp automatically includes your open IDE's file and text selection
      with every message.
  --no-ide
      Disable IDE connection
  --mcp-config <value>
      JSON configuration or file path for MCP servers to merge with existing settings
  -m, --mode <value>
      Set the agent mode (low, medium, high, ultra, or a plugin mode by key or label, case-insensitive) — controls the
      model, system prompt, and tool selection
  --features <value>
      Enable a thread feature (known: fast, Faster serving for supported models, billed at a premium; pro, GPT-5.6 Pro
      mode (OpenAI API only, not supported by ChatGPT subscriptions))
  --fast
      Run new threads in Fast mode (faster serving for supported models, billed at a premium); alias for --features fast
  --executor <value>
      Run a new thread locally, in an orb, or on a runner (local, orb, runner:<id>)
  --no-tui
      Run Amp without a TUI: serve remote thread creation requests for the current directory. Use --runner-id <id> to
      set a stable runner ID.
  --remote-control-terminal
      Enable terminal access from ampcode.com for remote-controlled threads
  --no-remote-control-terminal
      Disable terminal access from ampcode.com for remote-controlled threads
  -x, --execute [message]
      Use execute mode, optionally with user message. In execute mode, agent will execute provided prompt (either as
      argument, or via stdin). By default, only the last assistant message is printed. Enabled automatically when
      redirecting stdout.
  -ox, --orb-execute
      When used with -x/--execute, execute in an async orb on the Amp server. The -ox shorthand enables both options.
      With `threads continue`, sends the message to the existing thread so it runs on that thread’s own remote executor.
  --project [project]
      With the orb executor, run the new thread on this Amp project (namespace/name, owner/repo, or repository URL)
      instead of inferring it from the current directory’s Git remotes.
  --orb-size <size>
      With the orb executor, use this size instead of the project default.
  --title <title>
      With --execute, set the title of the new thread before starting the agent.
  --stream-json
      When used with --execute, output in Claude Code-compatible stream JSON format instead of plain text.
  --stream-json-thinking
      Include thinking blocks in stream JSON output (non-Claude Code extension). Implies --stream-json.
  --stream-json-input
      Read JSON Lines user messages from stdin. Requires both --execute and --stream-json.
  --plugin-ready-timeout [seconds]
      When used with --execute, how long to wait for plugins to become ready before running the turn, so plugin
      lifecycle hooks (agent.start/agent.end) are not skipped. Off unless this flag is set; the bare flag uses 10. Max
      300. Use 0 to disable.
  --no-archive-after-execute
      When used with --execute on a new thread or with the review command, leave the thread unarchived after the command
      finishes.
  -l, --label <label>
      Add a label to the thread created or continued by this command. Repeat the flag for multiple labels.

Environment variables:

  AMP_API_KEY                  Access token for Amp (see https://ampcode.com/settings/security#access-token)
  AMP_URL                      URL for the Amp service (default is https://ampcode.com/)
  AMP_LOG_LEVEL                Set log level (can also use --log-level)
  AMP_LOG_FILE                 Set log file location (can also use --log-file)
  AMP_REMOTE_CONTROL_TERMINAL  Enable (1) or disable (0) terminal access from ampcode.com when no CLI flag is supplied
  AMP_SETTINGS_FILE            Set settings file path (can also use --settings-file, default:
                               /home/user/.config/amp/settings.json)

Examples:

Start an interactive session:

  $ amp

Start an interactive session with a user message:

  $ echo "commit all my unstaged changes" | amp

Use execute mode (--execute or -x) to send a command to an agent, have it execute it, print only the agent's last message, and then exit:

  $ amp -x "what file in this folder is in markdown format?"
  All Markdown files in this folder:
  - README.md (root)
  - AGENT.md (root)
  - Documentation (7 files in doc/)
  - Various README.md files in subdirectories
  Total: **13 Markdown files** found across the project.

Stream JSON output and extract assistant text blocks with jq:

  $ amp -x "what file in this folder is in markdown format?" --stream-json | jq -r 'select(.type=="assistant") | .message.content[] | select(.type=="text") | .text'

Stream JSON output with thinking blocks and extract them with jq:

  $ amp -x "what file in this folder is in markdown format?" --stream-json-thinking | jq -r 'select(.type=="assistant") | .message.content[] | select(.type=="thinking") | .thinking'

Pipe data to the agent and send along a prompt in execute mode:

  $ cat ~/.zshrc | amp -x "what does the 'beautiful' function do?"
  The `beautiful` function creates an infinite loop that prints the letter "o" in cycling colors every 0.2 seconds.

Execute a prompt from a file and store final assistant message output in a file (redirecting stdout is equivalent to providing -x/--execute):

  $ amp < prompt.txt > output.txt

Add an MCP server with a local command:

  $ amp mcp add context7 -- npx -y @upstash/context7-mcp

Add an MCP server with environment variables:

  $ amp mcp add postgres --env PGUSER=orb -- npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-postgres postgresql://localhost/orbing

Add a remote MCP server:

  $ amp mcp add hugging-face https://huggingface.co/mcp

Configuration:

Amp can be configured using a JSON settings file located at /home/user/.config/amp/settings.json. All settings use the "amp." prefix.

Settings reference:

  amp.dangerouslyAllowAll
      Disable all command confirmation prompts (agent will execute all commands without asking)
  amp.defaultVisibility
      Define default thread visibility per repository origin using mappings like "github.com/org/repo": "workspace".
      Values: private, workspace, group.
  amp.experimental.modes
      Enable experimental agent modes by name
  amp.fuzzy.alwaysIncludePaths
      Glob patterns for paths that should always be included in fuzzy file search, even if gitignored
  amp.git.commit.ampThread.enabled
      Enable adding Amp-Thread trailer in git commits
  amp.git.commit.coauthor.enabled
      Enable adding Amp as co-author in git commits
  amp.guardedFiles.allowlist
      Array of file glob patterns that are allowed to be accessed without confirmation. Takes precedence over the
      built-in denylist.
  amp.keymap
      Command shortcuts keyed by command ID. Values can be a shortcut string, an array of shortcuts, or null. User
      keymap entries override workspace entries. Run "amp config keymap" to list all command IDs, descriptions, and
      effective keys, with null for unbound commands.
  amp.mcpServers
      Model Context Protocol servers to connect to for additional tools
  amp.network.timeout
      How many seconds to wait for network requests to the Amp server before timing out
  amp.notifications.enabled
      Enable notification alerts when the agent completes tasks. Over SSH, or when AMP_FORCE_BEL is set, this sends a
      terminal bell.
  amp.notifications.system.enabled
      Enable system notifications when terminal is not focused
  amp.permissions
      Permission rules for tool calls. See amp permissions --help
  amp.proxy
      Proxy URL used for both HTTP and HTTPS requests to the Amp server
  amp.remoteThreadCreation.enabled
      Let ampcode.com create new threads that open in the interactive Amp TUI on this machine, in the directory where it
      was started
  amp.showCosts
      Set to false to hide costs while working on a thread
  amp.skills.disableClaudeCodeSkills
      Disable skills from .claude/skills/, ~/.claude/skills/, and ~/.claude/plugins/cache/. Local Amp skill directories,
      custom paths, built-in skills, Personal Skills, and Workspace Skills are not affected.
  amp.skills.path
      Path to additional directories containing skills. Supports colon-separated paths (semicolon on Windows). Use ~ for
      home directory.
  amp.terminal.animation
      Set to false to disable terminal animations (or use the equivalent NO_ANIMATION=1 env var)
  amp.terminal.copyOnSelect
      Automatically copy selection to clipboard.
  amp.terminal.detailsExpandedByDefault
      Expand thinking and tool call details by default in the CLI transcript.
  amp.thread.autoArchiveOnQuit
      Automatically archive open CLI threads when quitting Amp
  amp.tools.disable
      Array of tool names to disable. Use 'builtin:toolname' to disable only the builtin tool with that name (allowing
      an MCP server to provide a tool by that name).
  amp.tools.enable
      Array of tool name patterns to enable. Supports glob patterns (e.g., 'mcp__metabase__*'). If not set, all tools
      are enabled. If set, only matching tools are enabled.
  amp.updates.mode
      Control update checking behavior: "warn" shows update notifications, "disabled" turns off checking, "auto"
      automatically runs update.

Example configuration:

{
  "amp.dangerouslyAllowAll": false,
  "amp.defaultVisibility": {
    "github.com/ampcode/amp": "workspace"
  },
  "amp.experimental.modes": [],
  "amp.fuzzy.alwaysIncludePaths": [],
  "amp.git.commit.ampThread.enabled": true,
  "amp.git.commit.coauthor.enabled": true,
  "amp.guardedFiles.allowlist": [],
  "amp.keymap": {},
  "amp.mcpServers": {
    "filesystem": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem",
        "/path/to/allowed/dir"
      ]
    }
  },
  "amp.network.timeout": 30,
  "amp.notifications.enabled": true,
  "amp.notifications.system.enabled": true,
  "amp.permissions": [
    {
      "tool": "Bash",
      "action": "ask",
      "matches": {
        "cmd": [
          "git push*",
          "git commit*",
          "git branch -D*",
          "git checkout HEAD*"
        ]
      }
    }
  ],
  "amp.remoteThreadCreation.enabled": false,
  "amp.showCosts": true,
  "amp.skills.disableClaudeCodeSkills": false,
  "amp.terminal.animation": true,
  "amp.terminal.copyOnSelect": true,
  "amp.terminal.detailsExpandedByDefault": false,
  "amp.thread.autoArchiveOnQuit": false,
  "amp.tools.disable": [
    "browser_navigate",
    "builtin:edit_file"
  ],
  "amp.updates.mode": "auto"
}
